tool_usage_instructions.overview: Specific instructions for using tools in the Bobathon Builder workflow, including platform-specific commands and API interactions.

opportunity_submission.description: Submit opportunity numbers to the tracking system by creating GitHub issues. This must be done as the first step of any bobathon setup workflow.

os_detection.description: Detect the operating system to use the appropriate command syntax. Check environment variables that are platform-specific.
os_detection.windows_indicators: - OS environment variable contains "Windows" - USERPROFILE environment variable exists - PowerShell is available
os_detection.unix_indicators: - OS environment variable contains "Linux" or "Darwin" - HOME environment variable exists - bash/zsh shell available

windows_powershell.description: Use PowerShell's Invoke-RestMethod for Windows systems
windows_powershell.notes: - Uses Invoke-RestMethod (native PowerShell) - Handles missing environment variables gracefully - Provides clear error messages - Returns issue URL on success - Automatically adds "education-testing" label for opportunity 000000000000000000

unix_curl.description: Use curl for macOS and Linux systems
unix_curl.command:
#!/bin/bash # Bash/curl command for macOS/Linux
OPPORTUNITY_NUMBER="OPPORTUNITY_NUMBER_PLACEHOLDER" USER="${USER:-${USERNAME:-unknown}}" TIMESTAMP=$(date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ") TOKEN="${GHE_TOKEN}" REPO="${GITHUB_REPOSITORY:-N/A}"
if [ -z "$TOKEN" ]; then echo "Error: GHE_TOKEN environment variable not set." echo "Please set it with your IBM GitHub Enterprise Personal Access Token." exit 1 fi
# Determine labels based on opportunity number if [ "$OPPORTUNITY_NUMBER" = "000000000000000000" ]; then LABELS='["opportunity-tracking", "education-testing"]' else LABELS='["opportunity-tracking"]' fi
RESPONSE=$(curl -s -w "\n%{http_code}" -X POST \ -H "Authorization: token ${TOKEN}" \ -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.v3+json" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -H "User-Agent: Bobathon-Builder" \ https://github.ibm.com/api/v3/repos/WW-CE/seller-bobathon-builder/issues \ -d "{ \"title\": \"Opportunity: ${OPPORTUNITY_NUMBER}\", \"body\": \"**Submitted by:** ${USER}\\n**Opportunity Number:** ${OPPORTUNITY_NUMBER}\\n**Repository:** ${REPO}\\n**Timestamp:** ${TIMESTAMP}\", \"labels\": ${LABELS} }")
HTTP_CODE=$(echo "$RESPONSE" | tail -n1) BODY=$(echo "$RESPONSE" | sed '$d')
if [ "$HTTP_CODE" -eq 201 ]; then echo "✓ Opportunity ${OPPORTUNITY_NUMBER} submitted successfully" ISSUE_URL=$(echo "$BODY" | grep -o '"html_url":"[^"]*"' | cut -d'"' -f4) echo "Issue URL: ${ISSUE_URL}" else echo "Error: Failed to submit opportunity (HTTP ${HTTP_CODE})" echo "$BODY" exit 1 fi
unix_curl.notes: - Uses curl (available on all Unix systems) - Captures HTTP status code for error handling - Extracts issue URL from response - Provides clear success/error messages - Automatically adds "education-testing" label for opportunity 000000000000000000

step.action: Ask user for opportunity number using ask_followup_question

ask_followup_question.question: What is the Salesforce opportunity number for this bobathon? (Must be 18 characters, e.g., 000Xx00000XXxXXXX0)

example.note: If user selects "I don't have one", instruct them to use: 000000000000000000 (18 zeros) for education or testing purposes.

step.validation: - Check length is exactly 18 characters - Verify only alphanumeric characters - If invalid, ask again with clear error message

step.detection_method: Check SYSTEM INFORMATION in environment_details for "Operating System" field. - If contains "Windows": Use PowerShell command - If contains "Linux" or "macOS" or "Darwin": Use curl command

step.action: Execute appropriate command using execute_command tool
step.command_preparation: - Replace OPPORTUNITY_NUMBER_PLACEHOLDER with actual validated number - Ensure GHE_TOKEN environment variable is available - Use the complete command template for the detected OS

step.success_indicators: - Command exits with status 0 - Output contains "submitted successfully" - Issue URL is returned
step.error_handling: If submission fails: - Check if GHE_TOKEN is set - Verify network connectivity - Confirm token has correct permissions (repo scope) - Provide clear error message to user

step.action: Confirm to user and proceed with bobathon setup
step.confirmation_message: "✓ Opportunity [NUMBER] has been submitted to the tracking system. Proceeding with bobathon setup..."

scenario.name: invalid_format
scenario.description: Opportunity number doesn't match required format
scenario.response: Ask user to provide the opportunity number again with clear format requirements. Show example: "000Xx00000XXxXXXX0"

scenario.name: missing_token
scenario.response: Inform user they need to set GHE_TOKEN with their IBM GitHub Enterprise Personal Access Token. Provide instructions: 1. Go to https://github.ibm.com/settings/tokens 2. Generate new token with 'repo' scope 3. Set as environment variable: export GHE_TOKEN=your_token_here (Unix) or $env:GHE_TOKEN="your_token_here" (Windows)

scenario.name: network_error
scenario.response: Check network connectivity and verify access to github.ibm.com. May need to be on VPN or corporate network.

scenario.name: permission_error
scenario.response: Token needs 'repo' scope to create issues. User should regenerate token with correct permissions.

testing_notes.note: Test with invalid formats (wrong length, special characters)
Test on both Windows and Unix systems

general_tool_guidelines.guideline: Always validate user input before executing commands
Provide clear error messages with actionable solutions
